boss_acceptance_relevant.source_text: Tributum Stacking Start of Turn Deal 20% current HP damage to all allies at the frontline and stack Tributum based on damage dealt, (max stacks: 50 ) Number of stacks = 10 + total_ally_damage_dealt_by_Minalca / 100, rounded down Example: 4 allies with ~3400 current HP, will make 10 + (20%*13600)/100 = 37 stacks Max stacks when allies have 5000+ average current HP (or 20,000+ HP total) Damage done to Shield does not count Stacks are reset at turn end Stack effects: gradually affects power of some of user skill buffs and attacks.
